index.subtitle: The equipment that can be put on a load, and what is due for inspection.
index.emptyHint: Add the first unit. A load cannot be dispatched without a truck.
index.noResultsHint: Clear the filters to see everything you have access to.
index.searchPlaceholder: Unit number, VIN, plate, make or model

scope.assigned: Equipment of the carriers in your book

status.title: Service status
status.reasonRequired: Say why this unit is going out of service — at least five characters. It stays on the record and is shown on the loads it is released from.
status.doneAndReleased: Status changed, and the unit was released from {count} live load(s).

detail.axleSpacingsTotal: steer axle to last drive axle on this unit alone
detail.lessorNoRecord: (typed in by hand, no vendor record)

form.createSubtitle: A unit is added pending verification. It cannot be put on a load until someone has checked it.
form.carrierNotAllowed: That carrier is not one you can add equipment for.
form.unitNumberHint: As it is painted on the door. Unique within the carrier.
form.unitTaken: That carrier already has a unit {unit}.
form.vinHint: Not required, but it is how the unit is identified outside your own numbering.
form.vinTaken: That VIN is already on file as unit {unit}.
form.vinChecksum: That VIN does not add up — its check digit is wrong. Check it against the plate; nothing was filled in.
form.vinFilledLive: Filled in from the VIN and the NHTSA database: {fields}. Nothing you had typed was touched.
form.vinFilledOffline: Filled in from the VIN itself: {fields}. The model is not in the number, so type it yourself. Nothing you had typed was touched.
form.lessorHint: The company that leases this unit. Their record lives under Finance → Vendors.
form.ownershipOwnedHint: A unit you own has no lessor and no end date, so those two are cleared when you save.
form.axleSpacingsHint: Front to back, one gap at a time. Leave them all blank if nobody has measured them yet.
form.axleSpacingsNeedCount: Set the axle count first: the gaps are one fewer than the axles.
form.axleSpacingsMismatch: With {axles} axles you need {n} gaps, and they are not all filled in. Fill them all in, or leave them all blank.
form.axleSpacingZero: A gap cannot be zero. Leave both boxes blank if it has not been measured.
form.axleSpacingsMismatchOne: With {axles} axles you need {n} gap, and it is missing. Fill it in, or leave it blank.
form.lessorNoVendors: No leasing vendor on file. Add one under Finance → Vendors.
form.lessorTypedOnly: Typed in by hand: “{name}”. Pick the vendor above to tie this unit to its record.
form.lessorNotFound: That vendor does not belong to this company.

verification.title: Check against the policy
verification.hint: That this unit's VIN appears on the carrier's current certificate of insurance. A truck that is not on the policy runs uninsured, and nobody finds out until there is a claim.
verification.requiredToActivate: This unit cannot be put in service until somebody has checked it against the carrier's policy.
verification.reasonRequired: Write why it goes in service without the check. It stays with the unit.
verification.overridden: Unit put in service with the check overridden.
verification.confirm: I have seen this VIN on the policy
verification.overrideHint: Who did it and why is recorded, and shows on the unit from now on.
verification.no_coi_on_file: This carrier has no certificate of insurance on file. Ask for it and upload it before verifying.
verification.coi_expired: This carrier's certificate of insurance has expired. The new one is needed.
verification.overriddenOn: Put in service unverified on {date} by {name}.
verification.notExtracted: The system does not read the certificate: a person does. Open the document and check the VIN is on it.
verification.coi_not_approved: This carrier has a certificate of insurance that has not been approved yet. Review it before verifying the unit.

blockingTitle: This unit cannot go on a load:

media.title: Unit photos
media.hint: All four sides, before the unit goes in service. This is what documents the condition it left in — and what is missed nine months later, when somebody files a claim.
media.whyFourAngles: Four angles are required, not four files: four photos of the same headlight say nothing.
media.complete: All four sides are on file.
media.caption: Note (optional)
media.empty: No photos of this unit yet.
media.fileMissing: That photo is no longer in the store. The row names it and the file is not there, so there is nowhere to get it from: upload that angle again.

combos.title: Combos
combos.hint: What a truck measures WITH a trailer. The gap from the last drive axle to the first trailer axle belongs to neither record: it changes when either unit changes, and it is the one the bridge formula and the permit office ask for.
combos.hitchGap: Last drive axle to first trailer axle
combos.notesHint: An extendable RGN changes this gap load by load. Say so here, and adjust it on the permit.
combos.chainIncomplete: The overall distance needs the axle count and every gap on both records, plus this one.
combos.hitchRequired: The gap from the last drive axle to the first trailer axle is what this record is for. Without it there is nothing to save.
combos.zero: A measurement cannot be zero. Leave both boxes blank if nobody has taken it.
combos.truckNotYours: That truck is not one you can edit.
combos.trailerNotYours: That trailer does not belong to your company.
combos.emptyHint: A combo appears when a driver is given a truck and a trailer, or when you measure a pair here.
combos.bumperShorterThanChain: Bumper to bumper cannot be shorter than first axle to last axle: both overhangs sit outside the axles. Check which two points each measurement was taken between.
combos.axlesBehindRear: The trailer axles cannot sit behind the rear of the trailer. One of the two was measured from the other end.
